newsitem.title: POLAND: UNIONS AT POLIFARB-C CALL OFF STRIKE ALERT.
newsitem.headline: UNIONS AT POLIFARB-C CALL OFF STRIKE ALERT.

text.p: Trade unions at the Polish paint maker Polifarb-Cieszyn SA called off the strike alert which they had announced last week to protest against the planned move of the compny's headquarters, the firm's president said.

PAP news agency quoted Bernard Andrzejewski as saying the strike readiness was abandoned because the unions had reached an agreement with the board which envisages a three-year guarantee that the company's 950 jobs will be kept.

The unions would no longer oppose the moving of Polifarb Cieszyn's headquarters to the city of Wroclaw under the firm's planned merger with another paint-maker Polifarb-Wroclaw, or question any other merger decisions of the board.
Analysts say the merger of the two companies, planned for July, is likely to give them a 40 percent share of the Polish paint market.
